tests.name: short_keys_parse
tests.intent: Verify parsing of objects with short keys that fit within SSO buffer.

tests.name: long_keys_parse
tests.intent: Verify parsing of objects with long keys exceeding SSO buffer size to exercise move semantics.

tests.name: sso_boundary_key_parse
tests.intent: Verify parsing of object keys right at the SSO boundary length.

tests.name: escaped_keys_parse
tests.intent: Verify parsing of object keys containing escape sequences.

tests.name: empty_key_parse
tests.intent: Verify parsing of an object containing an empty string key.

tests.name: duplicate_keys_parse
tests.intent: Verify handling and last-one-wins semantics of duplicate keys during parse.

tests.name: nested_objects_keys
tests.intent: Verify key moving across deeply nested objects.

tests.name: unicode_keys_parse
tests.intent: Verify parsing of multibyte UTF-8 characters within object keys.

tests.name: sax_dom_parser_direct_key
tests.intent: Verify direct invocation of json_sax_dom_parser via sax_parse with custom input.

tests.name: ordered_json_keys_parse
tests.intent: Verify key parsing behavior with ordered_json where ordered_map is used instead of std::map.

tests.name: stream_parsing_keys
tests.intent: Verify parsing of object keys using std::istringstream input adapter.

tests.name: many_keys_parsing
tests.intent: Verify object parsing with a large number of keys to stress container insertion and key moving.

tests.name: json_diagnostics_keys_parse
tests.intent: Verify parsing behavior with diagnostics enabled on object keys.

tests.name: empty_object_keys
tests.intent: Verify parsing of an empty object where key method is never invoked.

tests.name: mixed_type_values_keys
tests.intent: Verify parsing keys of objects containing mixed value types.

tests.name: parser_accept_check
tests.intent: Verify json::accept() on valid object strings ensuring lexer and parser states behave properly.

tests.name: from_cbor_object_key
tests.intent: Verify parsing object keys from CBOR binary representation.

tests.name: from_msgpack_object_key
tests.intent: Verify parsing object keys from MessagePack binary representation.

tests.name: from_ubjson_object_key
tests.intent: Verify parsing object keys from UBJSON binary representation.

tests.name: key_with_null_characters
tests.intent: Verify parsing of object keys containing embedded null characters if supported by string representation.
